claims.claim: MobileBERT uses inverted-bottleneck IB-BERT teacher and a compact student for resource-limited devices
claims.verification_note: Teacher is specially designed and not necessarily ordinary BERT-large.

claims.claim: MobileBERT incorporates bottleneck architecture and stacked feed-forward structures
claims.verification_note: Distinguish outer hidden from inner bottleneck and stacked FFN configuration.

claims.claim: Common MobileBERT config values 512 hidden, 128 intra bottleneck, 24 layers, four FFNs
claims.verification_note: Defaults not universal to all community checkpoints.

claims.claim: Quantization variants require calibration for static activations and compatible operators
claims.verification_note: Engineering guidance not an original MobileBERT-paper claim.

claims.claim: MobileBERT paper compares downstream SQuAD dev F1 and edge inference efficiency
claims.verification_note: Do not import reported device latencies as current device guarantees.

claims.claim: Narrowing internal matmul dimensions reduces some costs but layer depth and extra projections remain
claims.verification_note: 512x128 parameter count is a toy standalone projection calculation.
